coverage: Tuesday 25 Aug 2026 pre-Asia-open run (~07:02-07:55 SGT). tldr: Monday's Iran-sanctions rollout ('Operation Economic Outcast') landed with phased, not immediate, secondary sanctions and did not name China directly -- oil sold off 2.5% on 'sell the news' rather than spiking, defusing the week's first binary catalyst without a shock.

Gold extended to a 3-month high (GLD $426.69) and Bitcoin pushed toward $80k on the same Treasury-buyback dollar-weakness trade -- the debasement leg of the book (silver/gold miners) remains the strongest theme on the tape.

Chip stocks sold off Monday (Micron -5.8%, AMD -3.3%, Nvidia -2.3%) pre-earnings, with a matching KOSPI -3.1% session in Korea and a Hang Seng pullback -- Wednesday's Nvidia FQ2 print is now one trading day away and the cleanest read on whether the AI-capex-fatigue scare is real.
